test_title: PYST 48: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight teachers Kamal, Abhi, Gopal, Hemlata, Rachit, Palak, Kajal and Luna are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

Abhi is second to the left of Hemlata. Palak is third to the right of Hemlata. Gopal is second to the right of Kamal. Palak is second to the left of Kamal. Kajal is third to the left of Rachit. Who is sitting second to the left of Hemlata?
solution:
Given; Eight teachers Kamal, Abhi, Gopal, Hemlata, Rachit, Palak, Kajal and Luna are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre.

1) Abhi is second to the left of Hemlata.

2) Palak is third to the right of Hemlata.

3) Gopal is second to the right of Kamal.

4) Palak is second to the left of Kamal.

5) Kajal is third to the left of Rachit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52e137f3a6b3a3687e722accb24680ec09c86e11b5a29d51d775220bfd739fb5.png] 

So, **Abhi** is sitting second to the left of Hemlata.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Abhi".**
